paper.why: The foundational treatment of the cosmic-ray streaming instability and self-generated Alfven-wave scattering — the microphysical basis of CR diffusion and confinement in the interstellar medium.

paper.title: The October 22, 1989, solar cosmic ray enhancement: An analysis of the anisotropy and spectral characteristics
paper.why: Classic demonstration of deriving SEP energy spectra, anisotropy and pitch-angle distributions from the global neutron-monitor network — the methodological landmark for reconstructing GLE spectra from neutron monitors.

paper.title: The Origin of Ultra-High-Energy Cosmic Rays
paper.why: Introduces the 'Hillas criterion' (magnetic-confinement condition B x R) and the Hillas plot that is the universal starting point for evaluating candidate UHECR source classes; indispensable for the candidate-sources part of the overview.

source_reviews: Potgieter 2013 — Solar Modulation of Cosmic Rays
Giacalone et al. 2022 — Anomalous Cosmic Rays and Heliospheric Energetic Particles
paper.title: The passage of energetic charged particles through interplanetary space
paper.why: Introduces the Parker cosmic-ray transport equation — the foundational framework (diffusion, convection, drift, adiabatic energy change) for modeling particle transport and modulation throughout the heliosphere, indispensable for the modulation-in-the-outermost-heliosphere prong of the need.

paper.first_author: Aab, A. et al. (Pierre Auger Collaboration)
paper.title: The Pierre Auger Cosmic Ray Observatory
paper.why: The definitive instrument-description paper for the world's largest UHECR observatory (hybrid surface-detector + fluorescence design); directly serves the 'main experimental techniques and observatories' requirement.

paper.first_author: Abu-Zayyad, T. et al. (Telescope Array Collaboration)
paper.title: The surface detector array of the Telescope Array experiment
paper.why: The canonical description of the largest Northern-hemisphere UHECR detector; needed to balance Auger and cover the second flagship observatory and its hybrid air-shower detection technique.

paper.title: The Two Sources of Solar Energetic Particles
paper.why: Canonical statement of the two-source SEP paradigm (impulsive flare/reconnection acceleration vs gradual CME-driven-shock acceleration) — the flares-vs-shocks framing the introduction is built around.

paper.title: Three Unusual Cosmic-Ray Increases Possibly Due to Charged Particles from the Sun
paper.why: The discovery paper of ground-level enhancements — the first detection of solar particles at ground/neutron-monitor level; the historical origin point for how GLEs are observed.

paper.title: Time Dependence of the Electron and Positron Components of the Cosmic Radiation Measured by the PAMELA Experiment between July 2006 and December 2015
paper.why: First continuous charge-separated (e- vs e+) time series spanning a solar minimum through the 2013-2014 polarity reversal, providing the direct observational evidence of charge-sign-dependent drift the need explicitly asks about.

paper.title: Time dependence of the proton flux measured by PAMELA during the 2006 July - 2009 December solar minimum
paper.why: The decisive PAMELA measurement giving near-monthly proton spectra down to ~400 MV through solar cycle 23's minimum — the canonical space-borne dataset tracking the time variation of cosmic-ray flux over the solar cycle.

source_reviews: Engelbrecht et al. 2022 — Theory of Cosmic Ray Transport in the Heliosphere
paper.title: Transport coefficients of low-energy cosmic rays in interplanetary space
paper.why: The observational 'Palmer consensus' on measured parallel mean free paths that any turbulence-based scattering theory must reproduce — the empirical benchmark tying turbulence to cosmic-ray diffusion.

source_reviews: Bruno & Carbone 2013 — The Solar Wind as a Turbulence Laboratory
paper.title: Turbulence, Viscosity, and Dissipation in the Solar-Wind Plasma
paper.why: The founding identification of the solar wind as a turbulent medium with a power-law magnetic fluctuation spectrum, opening the whole subject of IMF turbulent power spectra the need asks about.

paper.title: Understanding and mitigating gradient flow pathologies in physics-informed neural networks
paper.why: The landmark loss-weighting paper — diagnoses imbalanced gradients between residual and boundary terms and introduces adaptive weighting, the canonical citation for the loss-weighting innovation the need asks about.

paper.first_author: Zatsepin, G. T. & Kuz'min, V. A.
paper.title: Upper Limit of the Spectrum of Cosmic Rays
paper.why: The independent Soviet co-prediction of the GZK cutoff, always co-cited with Greisen as the 'GZK' physics that frames the UHECR spectrum's expected steepening; a search on this need must surface it (JETP Lett. 4, 78; no registered DOI, omitted).

source_reviews: Giacalone et al. 2022 — Anomalous Cosmic Rays and Heliospheric Energetic Particles
Potgieter 2013 — Solar Modulation of Cosmic Rays
paper.title: Voyager 1 explores the termination shock region and the heliosheath beyond
paper.why: The decisive in-situ measurement: Voyager 1's termination-shock crossing showed ACR helium intensity did NOT peak at the shock, creating the 'Voyager paradox' that reframed where and how ACRs are accelerated in the heliosheath.

paper.title: Voyager 1 Observes Low-Energy Galactic Cosmic Rays in a Region Depleted of Heliospheric Ions
paper.why: The heliopause-crossing paper reporting the first in-situ galactic cosmic-ray H, He, and electron spectra outside the heliosphere — the direct measurement of the unmodulated input the need centers on.

source_reviews: Camps-Valls, Gerhardus, Ninad, Varando, Martius, Balaguer-Ballester, Vinuesa, Diaz, Zanna & Runge 2023 — Discovering causal relations and equations from data (Physics Reports 1044)
paper.title: Weak SINDy for partial differential equations
paper.why: Weak/integral-form reformulation of SINDy that eliminates pointwise derivative estimation to give orders-of-magnitude better noise robustness — the landmark answer to the need's explicit noise/limited-data question.

paper.title: When and why PINNs fail to train: A neural tangent kernel perspective
paper.why: Provides the NTK theory of PINN spectral bias / convergence failure and motivates adaptive schemes — the primary theoretical reference for known PINN failure modes.
